children: Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye will hold talks with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva this week, Bloomberg News reported on Monday citing an email statement.
They will discuss "recent economic developments and Senegal’s economic reform program", the report added.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
